answer: The lantern is the proof, the forge is what a faker must pay for, and the sparrow is the record the next epoch checks. Before any reward, the agent must show Regal plasterer permit with plasterers attestation — a permit plasterers renew after site audits. Each plasterer spends 4 winters learning the trade and passes 5000 site inspections; a faker pays the same for every copy. A faker would have to earn all three from scratch.
